title: 第十五章 渡雷劫第十六章 没见过那么不要脸的
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: 原本还高傲昂着头跟大胖对峙的四不像，早已五体投地软趴趴的不敢动，呼吸声都小了。
那来自地底的龙吟不仅大胖和四不像听到了，就是范沐禾他们也都听到了。
“那…那是什么？”
沸界河因为趴在地上，所以听得更为真切，甚至感觉神魂都受到了威胁。
“快帮我离开，我要离开！”
沸界河直觉要有不好的事发生。
他想离开这里，但是无论他怎么努力都爬不起来。
本来就被天雷竹给劈了，又被那些桃树给抽空了魔气，被净化之力压趴在地，动也动不了。
嗓子都嚎破了，也没人理他。
同一时间生命受到威胁的范沐禾，也赶紧带着莲花和荷花离开。
至于玄稷她并不是不想带这一起逃遁，一是离得太远，二是小娃在桃树围城的净化阵中心，即便是她进去也根本来不及逃出来。
她直觉那天雷根本就不会劈小娃。
小娃不是受天道庇护的吗，她一定会没事的。
就是地底传出来的奇怪龙吟声，有可能跟那小娃有直接关系。
刚才小娃气息攀升到筑基期的时候，她背后显现的龙纹，虽然只是短暂的一闪而过，她也看得清清楚楚的。
她突然想起囚笼界的传说，曾经在一本上古古籍上也看到过。
据说囚笼界就是专门为囚真龙而存在的界面。
她惊讶，自己可能发现了小娃的身世。
怪不得明明就是个凡人小娃，却能不惧魔邪，还能随手种出那些极品灵植。
这些不正是那上古古籍所记载的真龙才有的特性。
且还得是血脉极为纯净的龙族才会有的特性！
范沐禾内心的震惊无法表达，正跑着突然发现自己好像被天道给锁定了。
她头顶上正在集结恐怖雷云。
呔！小娃身世果然逆天吗？
天道连想都不准想！
她赶紧摒弃脑中的想法，同时拿出所有逃命的东西，防御的也都一股脑罩上自己。
见雷劫锁定的只有自己，把荷花莲花直接扔下，还能跑得更快点。
燃烧神魂之力拼命窜逃。
跑了差不多有万里之遥，才感觉那雷劫没再锁定她了。
同时她也虚脱了。
也不知道小娃那边怎么样了。
范沐禾赶紧把剩下的狗尾巴草都给吃了，补充魔气，又吃了个桃子，把浑身的魔气一压一压。
先把自己伪装成正道元婴期修士，先骗过天道，能骗一点是一点，以免再被锁定。
小娃是一定要找回来的。
知道了小娃的身世，离开囚笼界，肯定只能从小娃身上找契机了。
content_en:
Si Xiang, who was originally confronting the big fat man with his head held high, had already surrendered to the ground and was so weak that he didn't dare to move, and his breathing was quiet.
Not only did Da Pang and Si Xiang hear the dragon roar coming from the ground, but Fan Muhe and the others also heard it.
"Then...what is that?"
Because Fei Jiehe was lying on the ground, he heard it more clearly, and even felt that his soul was threatened.
"Help me leave quickly, I want to leave!"
Fei Jiehe had a gut feeling that something bad was going to happen.
He wanted to leave here, but no matter how hard he tried, he couldn't get up.
He was originally split by the Thunder Bamboo, and the demonic energy was drained out by the peach trees. He was pressed to the ground by the power of purification, unable to move.
His throat was broken by howling, but no one paid attention to him.
At the same time, Fan Muhe, whose life was threatened, quickly left with Lianhua and Hehua.
As for Xuan Ji, it wasn't that she didn't want to take him with her to escape. First, he was too far away, and second, the little baby was in the center of the purification formation in Peach Tree Siege. Even if she entered, she wouldn't have time to escape.
She intuitively felt that the thunder would not hit the baby that day.
Isn't the little baby protected by heaven? She will be fine.
The strange dragon roar coming from the ground may be directly related to the little baby.
When the little baby's aura reached the foundation-building stage just now, the dragon pattern that appeared on her back was visible to her clearly even though it only flashed by briefly.
She suddenly remembered the legend of the cage world, which she had read in an ancient book.
It is said that the Cage World is an interface that exists specifically to imprison real dragons.
She was surprised that she might have discovered Xiaowa's life experience.
No wonder that even though he is just a mortal child, he is not afraid of evil spirits and can easily grow those top-quality spiritual plants.
Aren't these just the characteristics of the real dragon recorded in the ancient books?
And it must be a characteristic that can only be possessed by dragons with extremely pure blood!
Fan Muhe couldn't express the shock in his heart. As he was running, he suddenly realized that he seemed to be locked by the law of heaven.
A terrifying thundercloud was gathering above her head.
Hey! Is Xiaowa's life experience really against the heavens?
Tiandao is not even allowed to think about it!
She quickly discarded the thoughts in her mind, and at the same time took out all the tools to escape, and all the defensive tools were used to cover herself.
Seeing that the only person targeted by the thunder tribulation was himself, he dropped the lotus flower directly and could run faster.
Burning the power of the soul, he ran away desperately.
After running almost ten thousand miles away, she felt that the lightning tribulation had no longer locked onto her.
At the same time she collapsed.
I don’t know what’s going on with Xiaowa.
Fan Muhe quickly ate all the remaining dogtail grass to replenish his demonic energy, and then ate a peach to suppress the demonic energy all over his body.
First, disguise yourself as a monk in the Nascent Soul stage of the righteous way, and deceive the way of heaven first, and deceive as much as you can, so as not to be locked out again.
The little baby must be found.
After knowing Xiaowa's life experience, leaving the cage world will definitely only find an opportunity from Xiaowa.
title_en: Chapter 15: Overcoming the Thunder Tribulation Chapter 16: I’ve never seen anyone so shameless
